data_fields.name: outlaw_clear_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: flag cleared when the player leaves the membership set on a pulse

best_idea: Scope the wanted flag to a place: set it on a hostile act inside a rival zone, clear it by diffing who is inside on a short pulse, and have guards check the flag before any KOS list.
decision_why: Keep the place-scoped flag and membership-diff clear; replace the nation/guild/player triple with one faction id, fix the isActive and null defects, and keep the flag server-side with the radius as zone data.
acceptance: A server test: a player who swings inside a rival-faction zone is flagged, the zone guards aggro within one tick, the flag clears within one pulse (2 s) after leaving the zone bounds, and a deactivated guild entry no longer draws guards.
